channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Owners of fire-destroyed Palisades mobile home park seek to displace residents for development deal
item.description: An offering memorandum described the destroyed mobile home park as a "blank canvas for redevelopment"; however, city officials reiterated they intend to let fire survivors return and rebuild.

item.title: Trump vows to select Iran's new leader, but Tehran is digging in
item.description: The U.K. and France committed bases to the U.S. war effort, and Ukraine will train Western powers in antidrone strategy as allies brace for a protracted war.

item.title: LeBron James breaks another Kareem Abdul-Jabbar record in loss to Nuggets
item.description: Lakers star LeBron James breaks Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's record for most career field goals in the regular season during a 120-113 loss to Denver.

item.title: Satellite photos show California's sudden snowpack meltdown: Now you see it, now you don't
item.description: Satellite images show the Sierra Nevada before and after a major heat wave melted significant portions of California's snow.

item.title: Paralympians focusing on Milan-Cortina Games amid tensions over Iran and Russia
item.description: Athletes competing at the Milan-Cortina Paralympics are trying to stay focused on their events amid war breaking out in Iran and tensions over Russia's involvement in the Games.

item.title: This hip L.A. neighborhood is installing emergency sirens to warn of ICE raids
item.description: Community activists are installing sirens across Highland Park in hopes of providing warnings on mobile devices to residents about possible ICE raids.

item.title: Dodgers work with Andrew Toles' family to continue supporting former outfielder
item.description: The Dodgers said it was no longer possible to renew Andrew Toles' contract and the team is working with his family to figure out "how to best move forward."

item.title: Feds say 18th Street boss 'Moms' led gang for imprisoned Mexican Mafia husband
item.description: Prosecutors charged seven alleged gang members and associates of the gang with racketeering and other charges, accusing them of taking orders from a Mexican Mafia member held in a California state prison.

item.title: Trump fires Kristi Noem, ending her turbulent reign heading Homeland Security
item.description: Trump said on social media he will appoint Oklahoma Sen. Markwayne Mullin to lead the DHS, two days after Noem faced a grilling on Capitol Hill from GOP members as well as Democrats.

item.title: Anxiety grows among California Democrats as gubernatorial candidates rebuff calls to drop out
item.description: Despite a warning from the state Democratic Party chair that a crowded field could hand the governorship to a Republican, eight of nine major Democratic candidates filed their paperwork to run, betting they can build momentum before the June primary.
